Audemars Piguet Royal Oak Minute Repeater Supersonnerie 26591TI, back in titanium

Audemars Piguet added three Minute Repeater Supersonnerie references on 2 November 2026. The titanium Royal Oak is 42 mm, with a hand-wound Calibre 2953 and a 72-hour power reserve.

The other two are a pink gold Royal Oak (26591OR) and a Code 11.59 (26395BC).

Monochrome Watches calls the titanium model identical to the 2021 version. Prices are on request; Monochrome expects CHF 350,000 or more, checked 25 November 2026.

Which would you pick: the titanium Royal Oak or the pink gold?

Source: Notebookcheck (launch date); Monochrome Watches (specs and price expectation). Photo: Audemars Piguet, via Monochrome Watches.
